releases.notes:
### Added

- Added a Minecraft 26.3 Fabric/NeoForge compatibility line, including the current five heroes, skills, accessories, Assist controls and shared translations.

### Fixed

- Skill tooltips now expand each starred value into its adjacent formula and result, without stars in the full description. Guandao combo damage lines are clearer and show current attack damage before Growing Valor's separate combat bonus.
- Fixed Roman Legionaries on Minecraft 1.20.1 and 1.21.1 teleporting directly to an airborne owner and falling. They now use the shared safe-ground follow logic and stay put when no safe destination is available.

### Notes

- Updated skill descriptions in all shipped languages. Existing combat damage and balance values are unchanged.
- Restart the game and server after updating. Back up your world before upgrading Minecraft from 26.1.2 to 26.3.

releases.notes:
### Added

- Added Off, Protect and All modes to the Echo Summoner's Assist controls. Protect is the default and prevents Echoes from harming villagers, iron golems and tamed creatures, including retaliation and area damage.
- Added short skill descriptions with current values. Hold Alt for formulas and concise notes; release it to return. Skill body text is white, formulas and notes gray, attack terms red and level terms green.

### Changed

- Updated Roman, Aztec and Egyptian skills with level- and attack-based scaling, including Legion Endures, direct-hit curse damage, bleeding and armor-piercing arrows. Bleeding sources expire independently; only the strongest active source deals damage.
- Extended Aztec melee and sweep reach. Guandao's first three combo hits now apply a small vertical lift and briefly reduce the target's melee reach.
- Converted selected accessory attack and maximum-health bonuses to percentages. Day/night healing now restores 1 health plus 1% of maximum health; Blood Pact Fang restores 2 health plus 5% of maximum health when triggered.
- Updated the summoner GUI, encyclopedia and Simplified Chinese/English text across Minecraft 26.1.2, 1.21.1 and 1.20.1.
- Updated skill formulas, Assist controls and accessory descriptions in all shipped languages, preserving localized terminology and formula colors.
- Long accessory effect tooltips now wrap to the window width while preserving their benefit/penalty colors.

### Notes

- Existing worlds are supported. Restart the client and server after updating; no new world or chunks are required.

releases.notes:
### Added

- Added optional Pet Home collar support across all six packages, plus Domestication Innovation support on Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. Collars, enchantments, names and supported cooldowns stay with the Echo Relic through dismissal, death, resummoning and relic transfers.
- Added localized feedback for unsupported pet-management actions and relic tooltips explaining saved collars and enchantment limits. All shipped languages are updated.

### Fixed

- Restored Minecraft 1.21.1 Follow takeover when another player holds the bound summoner. Successful takeover preserves health and collar attributes without charging extra fuel; a failed transfer keeps the previous Echo and controller.
- Stopped unnecessary repeated saves of idle collar data. Active enchantment cooldowns still retain their intended timing.
- Long pet-management and pet-compass failure messages now wrap above the hotbar at large GUI scales instead of being cut off at the screen edges.
- Long saved-collar explanations in relic tooltips also wrap to the available width while keeping their original text and colors.
- Protected collar replacement, attribute restoration and pet-compass actions against duplicate returns, stale Echo instances and unauthorized control. Ordinary pets retain their original behavior.

### Notes

- Echo Summoner ownership, fuel and active-Echo limits remain authoritative. Pet beds, capture nets and external ownership contracts cannot independently store, revive or transfer Echoes. Total Recall and Curse of Afterlife remain on the collar but their independent storage/revival effects are inactive.
- On Minecraft 26.1.2, Curse of Immaturity is also retained but inactive because Echoes have no baby form. Pet-compass recall on this version requires carrying the corresponding Echo Summoner.
- Verified Pet Home versions: 1.1.4 on 1.20.1 Fabric/Forge and 1.21.1 Fabric; 1.1.3 on 1.21.1 NeoForge and 26.1.2 Fabric/NeoForge. Domestication Innovation 1.7.1 was verified with Citadel 2.6.3 on 1.20.1 Forge. These mods remain optional and are not bundled.
- Representative multiplayer, save/reload and combat cases passed; this does not certify every enchantment combination, audiovisual effect or third-party modpack.
- Existing worlds are supported. Restart the game and server after updating; no world reset or new chunks are required. This is not a promise of arbitrary dependency removal or downgrades.

releases.notes:
### Added

- Added Suspicious Red Sand for battlefields generated on red sand across all supported Minecraft versions. Brushing it restores red sand instead of ordinary sand.
- Updated all shipped translations for the new red-sand block and item.

### Fixed

- Fixed a Minecraft 1.20.1 startup crash when Echo Warrior and LOL-new both modify attribute handling, including the tested combination with Apothic Attributes. Echo growth and LOL-new's own attribute handling are preserved.
- Fixed battlefield suspicious sand and gravel remaining as Echo Compass targets after rewards were collected with Lootr on Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric and NeoForge. Battlefield archaeology follows Echo Warrior's shared, one-time reward rules; other Lootr containers and unrelated archaeology keep their normal behavior.
- Existing battlefield blocks converted by Lootr are reconciled when their chunks load. Completed rewards release the old compass target without dropping another reward; unfinished blocks retain their loot table and seed and return to shared archaeology.

### Notes

- Lootr integration was verified with 1.21.1-1.11.38.127. The attribute fix was verified with LOL-new 1.0.6, both with and without Apothic Attributes 1.3.7 / Placebo 8.6.3, on Forge 47.4.26. These mods remain optional and are not bundled.
- Partial brushing progress on old Lootr battlefield blocks resets when they return to shared archaeology. Existing personal Lootr inventory records are not deleted.
- Existing worlds are supported. Red sand applies to newly generated battlefields, including replacements; existing ordinary-sand battlefields are not repainted. No world reset or new chunks are required.
- Restart the game and server after updating. Echo growth formulas, experience, fuel costs and summoner save data are unchanged.

releases.notes:
### Fixed

- Aligned the three rightmost accessory slots in the Echo Summoner on Minecraft 1.20.1 and 1.21.1. Item icons, hover highlights and click areas now match the slot artwork.
- Empty accessory slot tooltips now follow the actual slot positions.

### Notes

- Verified in-game at GUI scales 2, 3 and 4. No textures or gameplay values were changed.
- Minecraft 26.1.2 receives the matching version number; its accessory slots were already aligned.
- Existing worlds and installed accessories are supported. Restart the game and server after updating; no world reset is needed.
